name: Dumbbell Front Squat
setup: A dumbbell on each shoulder, ends resting on the front of the shoulders, elbows forward.
cues: Keep the elbows pointing at the wall ahead the whole rep.
Heel, big toe, little toe: press all three into the floor.
Sit down between your heels, then push the floor away to stand.

faults.fix: Press the heels into the floor and sit only as deep as they stay down.
Push the floor apart: knees out over your laces.
